verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo agents (issue-to-MR automation, vulnerability remediation) and an official MCP server suggest natural-language/agentic interaction is possible, but the evidence pack gives no detailed documentation of an actual NL command interface, chat syntax, or examples of users issuing natural-language commands to control the platform. Missing for 10: concrete NL command examples/docs, independent hands-on verification that natural-language commands reliably control GitLab actions, and detail on scope/limits of the agent's command surface.
